mapper.select: SELECT a.id,a.order_id,a.store_id,a.operator_type,a.operator_id,a.operator_staff_id,a.membership_kind,a.request_id,a.command_id,a.result,a.fail_reason,a.created_at,r.id verification_id,r.credential_id,r.order_version,r.verified_at,r.verify_method FROM verification_attempt a LEFT JOIN verification_record r ON r.command_id=a.command_id AND r.attempt_id=a.id AND r.order_id=a.order_id AND r.store_id=a.store_id AND r.operator_id=a.operator_id AND r.operator_type=a.operator_type AND r.membership_kind=a.membership_kind AND r.operator_staff_id IS NULL AND r.request_id=a.request_id WHERE a.command_id=#{command}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM verification_credential_command WHERE id=#{id} AND command_namespace=CAST('verification.complete' AS BINARY) AND state='SUCCEEDED'
